name: Java CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up JDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'
          cache: maven

      - name: Build with Maven
        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify

- `distribution: temurin` — change to `zulu`, `corretto`, `microsoft`, etc. as needed
- `java-version: '21'` — set your required version
- Uses `cache: maven` and `mvn verify`

If the project uses Gradle instead, replace the last two steps with `cache: gradle` and a `./gradlew build` run.
